scope: All eight original captures from the two represented global-completion budget journeys inspected directly. This is not a contrast audit, whole-app visual/accessibility review or physical/Mac runtime qualification.

captures.observation: Light phone: full four hours and up-to-four remaining at root and manual branch, complete missing-finished warning, Museum Todo and globally Done Lunch. Disabled controls retain native appearance; no contrast-audit acceptance.
Dark increased-contrast iPad: same four-hour upper bound and warning, independent List branch and source-precedence Done tick. Empty detail is intentional because no Item is selected.
Light phone: global reopen reveals both unchecked appearances and four hours exact remaining; missing-finished warning disappears while the manual branch still reports an unknown unfinished estimate.
Dark increased-contrast iPad: global reopen shows zero of two Done and four hours remaining with both local Todo appearances visible.

Light phone: both itinerary appearances completed, full four-hour manual List budget retained and zero remaining; child estimates total three hours. Museum local and Lunch global checkmarks remain visually distinct.
Dark increased-contrast iPad: two of two Done, root and branch zero remaining, full four hours and calculated three-hour child total remain visible.

Light phone after relaunch: standalone Morning List retains four-hour manual full, three-hour remaining, Museum Todo and globally Done Lunch. Crowded inline toolbar title remains a separate polish finding.

Dark increased-contrast iPad after relaunch: standalone List retains one of two Done, three hours remaining and four-hour manual full. Empty detail remains intentional; no whole-app accessibility claim.
